title: Choose the CodeQuest composition
question: All three use the approved Repair Field Manual world. Choose the layout that should govern the application shell and dashboards.

options.label: Diagnostic Desk
options.thesis: A dense diagnostic desk puts the current task beside evidence and system state.
options.viewport: A traditional left index frames a dense multi-panel operational workspace.
options.risk: Its density can make the primary procedure compete with supporting evidence.

options.label: Procedure and Margin
options.thesis: One dominant procedure occupies the page while a disciplined outer margin carries role evidence.
options.viewport: A narrow chapter rail and slim utility strip frame a two-thirds procedure and one-third diagnostics column.
options.risk: The fixed diagnostic margin needs careful collapse behavior on mobile.

options.label: Open Handbook
options.thesis: The active procedure owns the left page while student, teacher, and admin evidence share the right page.
options.viewport: An open spread uses the center fold as hierarchy, with a procedural left page and evidence-led right page.
options.risk: The literal spread can become cramped below wide desktop sizes.
